title: Wireless Driveway Alarm – You Hear When Someone Turns In
descriptionHtml:
The delivery van has been waiting for ten minutes

If the house sits a way back from the road, you hear nothing. The courier is standing at the gate, the dog notices before you do, and the visitor has rung twice before you even know someone is there. Same thing in the evening — except then it's not a package you're wondering about.

The sensor at the driveway, the chime in the kitchen

The sensor goes where the driveway turns in, and the receiver goes in the house. When someone passes, you get a signal right away — you choose which of the 38 ringtones should mean driveway, so you can tell it apart from the doorbell. No wire needs to be run, and the sensor can stay outside all year round.

Features

  • You know right away that someone has turned in – motion sensor at the driveway, signal inside the house
  • You can tell the driveway from the doorbell – 38 ringtones to choose from
  • No cable to bury – wireless between sensor and receiver
  • Stays outside all year round – weatherproof sensor, not an indoor gadget in a plastic shell
  • Ready to use out of the box – 1 sensor and 1 receiver in the set

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations. The product photo shows the item as it is.
